preconditions.expression: all(c in '()' for c in stdin)
preconditions.description: The input string consists only of '(' and ')' characters.
The input string is non-empty and has length at most 1,000,000.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '0 1' or (stdout.count(' ') == 1 and stdout.split()[0].isdigit() and stdout.split()[1].isdigit())
postconditions.description: The output is either '0 1' (no valid substrings) or two space-separated integers: the length of the longest regular bracket substring and the number of such substrings.

postconditions.expression: len(stdin) == 0 or (stdout != '0 1' and all(0 <= int(x) <= len(stdin) for x in stdout.split()))
postconditions.description: If the input is non-empty and valid substrings exist, the output integers are non-negative and do not exceed the input length.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '0 1' or (len(stdin) > 0 and any(len(s) > 0 and all(s.count('(') == s.count(')') and s.count('(') == sum(1 for i in range(len(s)) if s[:i+1].count('(') >= s[:i+1].count(')')) for s in [stdin[i:j] for i in range(len(stdin)) for j in range(i+1, len(stdin)+1)]))
postconditions.description: If the output is not '0 1', there exists at least one substring in the input that is a regular bracket sequence (balanced parentheses with no prefix having more ')' than '(').

postconditions.expression: stdout == '0 1' or (len(stdin) > 0 and (max_len, count) == (max(len(s) for s in [stdin[i:j] for i in range(len(stdin)) for j in range(i+1, len(stdin)+1)] if len(s) > 0 and all(s.count('(') == s.count(')') and s.count('(') == sum(1 for i in range(len(s)) if s[:i+1].count('(') >= s[:i+1].count(')'))), sum(1 for s in [stdin[i:j] for i in range(len(stdin)) for j in range(i+1, len(stdin)+1)] if len(s) > 0 and len(s) == max_len and all(s.count('(') == s.count(')') and s.count('(') == sum(1 for i in range(len(s)) if s[:i+1].count('(') >= s[:i+1].count(')')))) and stdout == f'{max_len} {count}')
postconditions.description: The output integers are the length of the longest regular bracket substring and the number of such substrings, computed by checking all possible substrings for regularity (balanced parentheses with no prefix having more ')' than '(').
